title: Concept: Source that allows insecure connections
description: nuget.config declares an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
